about_text: Computer Science engineer and Full Stack Developer with commercial experience since 2020. Day to day I build web applications in TypeScript, React and C#, but outside of work I like to go beyond web — I run my own homelab with dozens of services, build Smart Home setups (including custom IoT devices) and contribute to open source projects. I'm into AI — I self-host local LLMs, use AI agents and build my own. I'm a fast learner, I value well-written code and I'm not afraid of new technologies.
exp_sharply_desc: Working in a team of developers using Agile methodology. In 2024, Sharply was acquired by SoftIQ. Selected projects:
exp_sharply_project1: 2D/3D kitchen countertop configurator for Poland's largest manufacturer
exp_sharply_project2: Web platform for one of the largest used car dealers in Iceland
exp_sharply_project3: Web games for a major retail chain
exp_sharply_project4: Login and remote access application for Windows Server
exp_julkafit_desc: Built and maintained a website with an online store featuring digital ebook delivery. Technologies: Next.js, Amazon Lambda and Stripe.
exp_admin_desc: Administration of Office365, hosting, DNS and email services for two small real estate companies. General IT support.
project_resume_desc: A repository serving as a template for creating resumes using MarkDown. This resume was built using this template.
project_homelab_desc: Home infrastructure on two servers (Proxmox + TrueNAS) that I use daily. Services include media streaming, local cloud gaming with GPU passthrough, local AI models, and automatic reverse proxy and DNS. Everything managed as Infrastructure as Code.
project_hydrohomie_desc: Hydroponics controller on ESP32-C6 with a custom PCB designed using code. Soil moisture, water level and temperature sensors. Dynamic deep sleep for battery savings, Home Assistant integration via ESPHome.
project_jotcli_desc: CLI tool for AI-assisted academic writing. Gathers context, drafts content, reviews for academic rigor. CLI and interactive TUI modes. Distributed via Homebrew, Scoop and curl.
oss_desc: I actively contribute to open source projects I use — including Streamystats (Jellyfin analytics), ZeroClaw (AI agent) and Wolf (cloud gaming in Docker).
edu_technikum: Mechatronics Technical School No. 1 in Warsaw
